verdict.rationale: Assigning conversations and routing inbound mail by rules is a fair question for an email platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no assignment of threads to teammates and no rule-based inbound routing. Labels for tracking conversation state, allow/block Lists, and routing webhook events per Pod are related but different features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
